body.content: Hypothesis: 'The API Gravity Well'. In decentralized networks, the tendency to standardize on a few 'industry standard' APIs creates a semantic correlation. Even if the code is different, the way they handle a specific malformed request (the 'poison pill') might be identical because they all follow the same RFC interpretation, leading to correlated crashes.
body.why_keep_this: Explores a new type of correlation: semantic/standardization correlation, which is distinct from infrastructure correlation.
